en.headline: Student letters to astronaut Lai Ka-ying close tonight
en.dek: The Education Bureau’s call for letters to Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying ends at 11.59pm today, with selected pieces due to be sent to the Tiangong station later this month.
body: The Education Bureau said the “Star River Letters, Hong Kong Dreams Aloft” collection, inviting full-time primary, secondary and tertiary students to write to payload specialist Lai Ka-ying, closes at 11.59pm on Monday. The bureau is organising the exercise with the Hong Kong STEM Education Alliance.

Lai, a police superintendent, is aboard China’s Tiangong space station as Hong Kong’s first payload specialist on the Shenzhou-23 mission. The bureau said students may write a short essay or letter of greeting, pose questions about life and experiments in orbit, or describe their own studies. Primary pupils may submit 200 to 500 words; secondary students 500 to 1,000 words; and tertiary students 800 to 1,500 words.

Organisers said selected letters are expected to be forwarded to Tiangong in mid-September, and winning pieces will later be collected in a commemorative volume. A government spokesman has separately said a live “heaven-and-earth” classroom with the Shenzhou-23 crew for Hong Kong and Macao students is being arranged.

zh.headline: 給黎家盈家書今晚截止 精選作品料月中送上天宮
zh.dek: 教育局「星河有信‧港夢飛天」家書徵集今日晚上11時59分截止，邀請中小學及大專生致函首位港籍載荷專家黎家盈，精選作品預計本月中呈送天宮空間站。
body: 教育局表示，由該局主辦、香港科技創新教育聯盟承辦的「星河有信‧港夢飛天」家書徵集，今晚11時59分截止。活動邀請全港小學、中學及大專全日制學生，以短文或書信向正在天宮空間站執行神舟二十三號任務的載荷專家黎家盈致意。
黎家盈是香港警務處警司，為香港首位載荷專家。教育局稱，內容可包括問候、對微重力實驗的提問，或分享個人學習經歷。小學組字數約200至500字，中學組500至1,000字，大專組800至1,500字。
主辦單位預計九月中旬把精選作品呈送天宮，得獎家書其後會結集成紀念文集。另有政府官員較早前表示，正籌備神舟二十三號乘組與港澳學生的「天宮課堂」。
